bass.tags: Funk rock instrumental. A distorted electric bass guitar plays a syncopated, percussive riff featuring frequent slides and hammer-ons. The bass tone is characterized by heavy overdrive and a mid-range growl. A dry acoustic drum kit maintains a steady backbeat with a crisp snare and tight hi-hats. The tempo is 105 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the rhythmic bass line and the drum groove. The bass utilizes a pentatonic scale with occasional chromatic passing tones.

[Intro]
[distorted electric bass riff starts, syncopated eighth notes]
[acoustic drum kit enters, steady backbeat]

[Main Section]
[bass continues with percussive slides and hammer-ons]
[snare hits on beats 2 and 4, closed hi-hat eighth notes]

[Outro]
[bass riff repeats with slight variations]
[drums and bass fade out]

drums.tags: Afrobeat and highlife fusion featuring a prominent, syncopated electric bassline and clean, rhythmic electric guitar scratching. The percussion consists of a steady kick drum, woodblock hits on the off-beats, and a shaker providing a constant sixteenth-note pulse. A bright, staccato brass section provides intermittent melodic stabs and call-and-response patterns. The arrangement is centered around a repetitive, interlocking groove between the bass and the percussion. Key of G major, 115 BPM.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[syncopated electric bass enters]
[shaker and woodblock percussion]

[Section A]
[clean electric guitar rhythmic scratching]
[staccato brass section stabs]

[Section B]
[bass continues melodic ostinato]
[brass section call-and-response with guitar]
[steady kick drum pulse]

[Outro]
[brass section sustained final chord]
[percussion fades]

vocals.tags: Hardstyle track at 150 BPM in G minor. The arrangement features a distorted, pitched 909-style kick drum that provides both the rhythmic pulse and the sub-bass melody. A bright, detuned supersaw lead plays a syncopated, anthemic melody with heavy portamento. High-frequency percussion includes a sharp, metallic snare on the backbeat and constant sixteenth-note closed hi-hats. A cinematic breakdown section utilizes a lush, atmospheric pad with a long attack and a filtered vocal chop that repeats a rhythmic motif. The energy builds using a rising pitch shifter on a noise snare roll and a high-pass filter sweep on the lead synth before the drop. The drop reintroduces the distorted kick with a sidechained white noise burst on every beat.
